component.name: Claude Desktop
component.summary: Chat with Claude from your desktop

description.p: Claude Desktop brings Anthropic's AI assistant to your desktop: chat with Claude, attach files and screenshots, use voice dictation, start Claude Code sessions on your projects and connect MCP servers for tool use.
This is an unofficial AppImage repackaged from Anthropic's official .deb release. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic. Requires a Claude.ai account.
